svg.title: VikingSettlements feature overview
svg.desc: Explore the wild: villages placed by world generation, named settlers, village traders. Build your own: recruit villagers, settlement banner, put them to work. Hold the gates: native raid events, rival clans, tunable config. Six settler jobs: villager, lumberjack, farmer, builder, blacksmith, guard.

text.font-family: Georgia,'Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: Living NPC villages for Valheim — explore them, recruit them, rule them
